{{Otheruses|Sand|more=well}}
'''Sand wells''' or '''sink holes''' were dangerous natural phenomena on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Due to the seismic instability in some parts of the [[Doaba Badlands]], gigantic rifts could open into chasms hundreds of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] deep, then close again without leaving a trace of anything that had been under it on the surface at any time. The disappearance of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] and their settlement in the area that would be known as the [[Adsila Rifts]] was attributed to a sand well. The [[Ibhaan'I]] tribe, who lived near the Adsila Rifts, were particularly attuned to the phenomena, and could feel the approach of an opening sand well.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
